overview: Noos takes the place historically occupied by Piero Angela's "Superquark". The main topic remains the same as its predecessor's, with services exploring the latest scientific discoveries in a wide array of topics: medicine, genetics, neuroscience, biology, archaeology, paleontology, and more. Moreover, it also highlights important innovations in both the energy and environment fields.
title: Noos - L'avventura della conoscenza

overview: Superquark is a long-running Italian television program created by Piero Angela that brings science, history, nature, and technology to viewers through detailed documentaries and expert segments.
title: Superquark

overview: Comedy panel debate hosted by Jo Brand, in which teams captained by Bill Bailey and Ed Byrne put forward their views.
title: Head On Comedy with Jo Brand

overview: In the early years of the Republic of China, a bizarre police death case and a high-profile wealthy merchant murder case made headlines across all newspapers, with the perpetrator's identity shrouded in total mystery. No police officers could make any headway in the investigation. The victim's fiancée, Jiang Siyao, a once-famous teen detective who had retired for years, teamed up with her best friend Huo Yining, a policewoman, to track down the killers of her fiancé and father. With the help of Ye Shi'an, a wealthy young heir hiding his real identity, the three went through countless dangers along the way. Jiang Siyao not only deepened her bond with her best friend, but also developed a romantic spark with Ye Shi'an. After solving a series of connected unsolved cases one after another, the trio finally eradicated the evil forces that had lurked for years and untangled the long-held knot in Jiang Siyao's heart. As the investigation progressed, Jiang Siyao discovered that her fiancé, whom she thought was dead, was actually alive and had returned under a completely new identity.
title: Phoenix Sleuth

overview: Tycoon Gao Sheng has long monopolized motorcycle racing events, reaping huge profits through rigged gambling rings and shady gray-area deals. Three years ago, he secretly tampered with Lin Ye's racing car. Chen Mo spotted the vehicle abnormality right before the race, but with no time for full troubleshooting, he insisted on swapping cars with Lin Ye to protect his partner, only to end up severely disabled and forced to retire from the racing circle. The two have since cooperated covertly, one operating in the open and the other in the shadows, biding their time and quietly collecting evidence for a total comeback. Three years later, Gao Sheng repeats his old trick, sneaking in to modify the racing car overnight to murder his target. Lin Ye, who was already well-prepared, relied on his superb driving skills to easily break the deadlock, win the championship, and gain public opinion and discourse advantage. Qin Kai, a racer who has long been coerced and controlled by Gao Sheng, witnesses Lin Ye defy the odds again and again. Struggling between his conscience and fear, Qin Kai finally defects after hearing the murder order and hands over the critical recording. Lin Ye, Chen Mo, and Lao Zhou now hold old physical evidence, combined data, physical proof, and recordings, fully confirming all of Gao Sheng's crimes.
title: The Long Race

overview: Christopher Lee and Shou Lou star as a mismatched pair of fixers for the rich and powerful, but a mysterious rival throws their mission into disarray.
title: The Fixers

overview: For more than a hundred years, larger than life characters, many of whom are members of logging families who go back to the time when the West was being settled, have spent their days among towering trees and powerful machines and their nights in outposts far from the comforts of civilization. Ax Men tells their remarkable story, detailing the history of the logging industry and how technology has transformed life for today's logger, while the struggle of man versus nature stays the same. Danger is a full-time job, as these brave men put everything on the line each and every day to retrieve timber. Snapped cables, runaway logs and razor-sharp chainsaws are just some of the dangers that threaten their lives daily. Even with new technology that should make the job easier, it all boils down to the toughness and perseverance of the logging crews. Anything and everything can and does go wrong. Not everyone will survive, but those who do will earn their place in a long line of men who call themselves Ax Men.
title: Ax Men

overview: Minerva - La scuola is a teen drama series set in a military high school in Naples. It is a world that seems to belong to another era, where students are woken up at dawn for the flag-raising ceremony, where mobile phones and civilian clothes are not allowed, and where subjects include military tactics and fencing lessons. It is a world where love stories are forbidden and every mistake comes at a very high price.
title: Minerva - La scuola

overview: The story revolves around the life of Kenan, the son of the Kozan family—one of Çukurova's long-established families—and how his life changes after he meets the love of his life. The story begins in Germany and continues in the world of Adana, woven with strong family ties.
title: Güneşin Doğduğu Yer

overview: Vedran is a frustrated yet ambitious young writer, constantly struggling for attention and recognition. When he accidentally kills a drug dealer who has been terrorizing his neighborhood, he is hailed as a vigilante justice-seeker and becomes an overnight local celebrity - even though his true identity remains hidden. Realizing that it takes only one person to spark a revolution, he makes a choice that changes his life forever...
title: Frust

overview: Bai Luo An and CEO Huo Ling end their five-year marriage, with Bai Luo An leaving a letter behind. The story follows their complicated past and the misunderstandings that shaped their relationship. As they move forward separately, both face challenges, personal growth, and the ups and downs of love, loyalty, and emotional connection.
title: No More Pretense: Mr. Huo's Daily Desire for Reconciliation

overview: The Repair Shop experts visit some of the people who have been reunited with cherished mementos.
title: The Repair Shop: Beyond the Barn

overview: Li Xing Chen, a former criminal investigator now working as a traffic police officer, takes on a mysterious hit-and-run case on a rainy night. Entrepreneur Gao Yu Hai is killed in the crash, but the scene has already been tampered with by someone posing as a traffic officer, erasing crucial evidence. A special task force is formed, with Li Xing Chen leading the investigation. The driver, Shen Xi, appears to have no connection to the victim, but as the investigation deepens, Li Xing Chen uncovers layer after layer of lies. Just as the case is about to be ruled a traffic accident, Xiao Ze is found hanging in a remote forest, raising new suspicions. Following the trail into the past, Li Xing Chen discovers a connection to a dance competition. On the night of a dance production, Shen Xi takes poison onstage, leaving behind a recorded message revealing the devastating abuse she suffered at the hands of the powerful. As the truth behind the rainy-night crash finally comes to light, Li Xing Chen witnesses the tragedy of ordinary people caught beneath the shadow of power—and the tangled depths of human nature hidden behind what first appeared to be an accident.
title: Truth Under The Wheel

overview: Rescue workers, survivors and witnesses relive the traumatic events of the September 11 terror attacks. Some tell their story for the first time, of how a regular morning turned into a nightmare.
title: 9/11: Days That Shocked the World

overview: Yun Qingqing's life falls apart in an instant. Hoping to find a decent place to quietly end it all, she is instead tricked into becoming the acting manager of a guesthouse. Before she can make sense of her new life, she finds herself chased by debt collectors and caught in the sights of Shen Feng, the owner of a local tea plantation. To her surprise, Shen Feng turns out to be the online boyfriend she ghosted years ago. Amid the chaos and unexpected encounters of everyday life, Yun Qingqing gradually heals and rediscovers the courage to love—and to let herself be loved.
title: Love Express

overview: European wildlife is threatened like never before, but in the Carpathian Mountains it has found its last great refuge. Home to Europe's most extensive primeval forests and the continent's largest populations of bears, wolves and lynx, the Carpathians are a stronghold of biodiversity. Follow the lives of this remarkable wildlife over the course of a year to reveal how each species is connected to the wider ecosystem. Together, they sustain a landscape that protects biodiversity, stores carbon and safeguards life-giving water, making the Carpathians one of Europe's most vital natural treasures.
title: Into the Carpathian Wild

overview: Jang Gi U is a 32-year-old temporary high school teacher. Four years ago, he became the subject of an inappropriate rumor involving a student. As a result, he never took the teacher certification examination and has instead spent the years moving from one contract teaching position to another. Raised in a single-mother household, he grew up constantly hearing that he had to be someone with "no flaws in the eyes of others." He lives as a person who appears flawless, but his life feels dull and unremarkable. At least, that is what everyone says.
title: Mind the Boy

overview: Rybinsk is out, Vyborg is in, and instead of a visionary journalist, we have an ordinary postman. Modest 30-year-old Vitalik Tyunin lives with his mother and spends his days delivering mail across the city. Everything changes when he becomes an unwelcome witness to a crime. This absurd twist of fate sets off a chain of events that will keep Vyborg wide awake—a city where Zoya and Bayan, having arrived from Rybinsk on personal business, suddenly find themselves caught in the middle.
title: Подслушано в Выборге

overview: What does a modern cartoon character look like? On the search for a universal formula for creating the perfect cartoon character.
title: Невесомая жизнь

overview: Bai Suzhen has cultivated for five hundred years and is poised to become an immortal, yet an unfinished love tribulation robs her of an important memory. Commanded by the gods, she goes down to the mortal world to seek out Xu Xian and repay his kindness. Along with Xiaoqing, she steps into the human world and crosses paths with Xu Xian, a demon hunter haunted by his family's massacre, and Fahai, a disciple of Jinshan. Together, the four embark on a journey bound by fate.
title: Prelude of the White Snake

overview: When business magnate Miguel Ángel dies in a mysterious crash, his daughter Zoé and estranged wife Belén fight for control of his company.
title: Colisión

overview: A love story takes place on an Charo Island in Japan between South Korean Lee Yoo-Bin and Japanese Karin Shirahama. Lee Yoo-Bin failed big as a space planner in South Korea, while Karin Shirahama is a berry farmer, who suffers from an unknown illness.
title: Merry Berry Love

overview: Taqueros, cops and CrossFit champs haul massive weights, battle in hand-to-hand combat and conquer relentless physical trials for a juicy cash prize.
title: Habilidad física 100: México

overview: Leigh Francis reprises his role of Avid Merrion and along with Barunka O'Shaughnessy, as his wife and sister Sacha, opens a hotel in L.A. full of celebrities, including past favourites Craig David and George Michael.
title: Bo! in the USA

overview: Three players take on increasingly hard rounds of trivia to compete to win amazing prizes from Brat TV Studios' The Prize Wall.
title: The Prize Wall

overview: In Love is Blind: Nederland, 30 single men and women enter the pods in the hope of finding a genuine, lasting connection, without ever seeing the person they're talking to. They date in individual pods, separated by a thin wall, and have the chance to build an emotional connection before meeting face-to-face. If they feel they've found the right person, they can even get engaged before seeing each other for the first time. From there, the couples meet in person and find out whether their connection can survive outside the pods. They travel together, move in together, plan their weddings, and navigate the challenges of building a relationship in the real world. And then comes the ultimate test: the altar. Will they say ‘I do' and prove that love really is blind, or will they decide to go their separate ways?
title: Love is Blind: Nederland

overview: Those Who Can't follows three trouble-making teachers; Loren Payton, Billy Shoemaker and Andy Fairbell. More inept than the kids they teach, they're out to beat the system as they struggle to survive each day on their own terms. Joining them is Abbey, the school librarian with an in-suppressible passion for life. New challenges arise in Season 2 as the teachers struggle to deal with a principal regime change, which has dramatically shaken things up inside Smoot High. They're forced to take their schemes to greater lengths in order to keep their jobs, their friends and their 'dignity.' It's going to be a long year if they can make their way through it.
title: Those Who Can't
Di Hou Jin Ri En Ai Le Ma

overview: Since time immemorial, the Sky Rift has unleashed demonic chaos upon the mortal world. Shangguan Ziyan, a young demoness, and Yuanchu, a Taoist priest, are brought together by fate. As the two No.9 Hunters, they set out on a journey to mend the heavens. Ziyan is afflicted with the Stone Curse, which constantly reverses her yin and yang, shifting her between male and female. Yuanchu, meanwhile, is bound by a cruel fate: whom he loves shall perish. Through all their encounters with humans and demons alike, they come to realize that only their love can serve as the thread to patch the sky and save the world.
title: No.9 Hunter

overview: In 1965, a drilling accident in the Arihundi Gobi Desert led to the mysterious disappearance of prospector Chu Hanwen. Twenty years later, the Lenghu Oilfield received a mysterious signal from the abyss, reviving a long-forgotten case. Beneath the Gobi Desert lies an unknown life form called Hundi, capable of parasitizing humans, causing mutations, and establishing an underground network sharing consciousness. Chu Nanfei, Liang Yihan, Zhou Fanghua, and others venture into the perilous Gobi abyss, confronting both infected mutants and the ambitious "Natural Science Society" while facing familial trauma and moral dilemmas. Humans attempt to suppress or control this mysterious power, while the self-aware Hundi observes and learns from humanity. When all control measures fail, humans and the aliens set aside their conflict and jointly explore their shared awakening and future.
title: Abyssal Sentience

overview: Orphaned at a young age, Han Ning loses his sister in a bizarre kidnapping case. Determined to seek justice, he becomes a detective, using his natural profiling talent to catch criminals. When a strange murder takes place, it triggers a chain of subsequent homicides, and every single case is somehow tied to the unsolved disappearance of Han Ning's sister seven years ago...
title: Fragments of Truth

overview: Rutger Castricum investigates the story behind a word that is increasingly central to the social debate. At a time when 'the foreigner' is often designated as the cause of problems in the Netherlands, he speaks to twelve people who came here for various reasons. From refugees and migrant workers to people who have lived here for years and newcomers who are still looking for their place. In candid conversations, Rutger asks critical questions, searches for the man behind the label and shows that reality is often more nuanced than the debate suggests.
title: Rutger en de buitenlanders

overview: Big Day with Peter Schrager will originate from New York City and cover the biggest stories from across the sports world each day, blending reporting, interviews, unique perspectives and authentic conversations with the athletes, coaches, executives and personalities driving the day's biggest headlines. While fans can expect Schrager's trademark NFL insight and relationships, Big Day is built to celebrate the full sports landscape and the moments everyone will be talking about.
title: Big Day with Peter Schrager

overview: Sandi Toksvig treads in the footsteps of Ireland's literary greats, to find out how an island so modest in size and population has produced one of the world's greatest literary cultures.
title: Sandi's Ireland: A Literary Journey

overview: Hui Won, an ER nurse, transfuses her own blood to save Tae Yeong, a mob boss who arrives with a gunshot wound — only to discover his deadly secret: hemophilia. On the day of her wedding, her fiancé's betrayal leaves her with nothing. Tae Yeong hands her a contract: be his fake wife for one year. With 3 billion won and her father's medical bills on the line, Hui Won is locked away in his mansion. She pushes back against his cold obsession and control, but slowly uncovers the loneliness and warmth hidden beneath his ruthless exterior — and the more she tries to escape, the deeper she falls.
title: Run from Me if You Can

overview: Joe Lycett presents comedy, celebrity chat and chaos from his own pub, open for only one hour a week on a Friday night, with a guest manager on hand to keep things ticking over as well as guests from the world of comedy, star-studded punters and other regulars.
title: Live From The Lycett Arms

overview: WCW Monday Nitro was a weekly professional wrestling telecast produced by World Championship Wrestling, created by Ted Turner and Eric Bischoff. The show aired Monday nights on TNT, going head-to-head with the World Wrestling Federation's (WWF) Monday Night Raw from September 4, 1995 to March 26, 2001. Production ceased shortly after WCW was purchased by the WWF. The debut of Nitro began the Monday Night Wars, a ratings battle between the WWF and WCW that lasted for almost six years and saw each company resort to cutthroat tactics to try to compete with the competition. In mid-1996, Nitro began to draw better ratings than Raw based on the strength of the nWo storyline, a rebellious wrestling stable that wanted to take over WCW. Nitro continued to beat Raw for 84 consecutive weeks, forcing WWE owner Vince McMahon to change the way he did business. As the nWo storyline grew stagnant, fan interest in the storyline waned, and Raw began to edge out Nitro in the ratings. The turning point for the organizations came during mid April 1998 after Steve Austin won his first WWF title. From that week forward, Raw beat Nitro in the ratings by a significant amount, and WCW was never able to regain the success it once had. Besides broadcasting from various arenas and locations across the country (such as the Mall of America in suburban Minneapolis, Minnesota, from which the very first episode of Nitro was broadcast), Nitro also did special broadcasts from the Disney-MGM Studios in Orlando in 1996, and did annual Spring Break-Out episodes from Panama City Beach, Florida starting in March 1997. The rights to WCW Monday Nitro now belong to WWE.
title: WCW Monday Nitro

overview: Four teens face the challenges of growing up as they sing and dance their way toward an elusive record deal as a girl group.
title: The Cheetah Girls

overview: Rags-to-riches style icon Tommy Hilfiger hosts The Cut, the search for America's next top fashion designer. 16 style-savvy contestants compete for the opportunity to design their own collection under the Tommy Hilfiger label. The contestants must complete a series of tasks that showcase their design and business skills to prove they have what it takes to make the cut in the fashion world.
title: The Cut

overview: A young Carnatic prodigy carries the weight of his grandfather's name and his family's survival. As financial pressure mounts and a long-buried family conflict resurfaces through his uncle Thyagaraju, Balu is pushed to question everything he's been trained to honor. An unexpected creative partnership forces him to see his tradition, and his family, in a new light.
title: Jagamae Sangeetham

overview: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show returns with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.
title: The Grand Tour

overview: Sweet Deceit challenges teams of three competitors to search for deceptive, hyper-realistic sweets hiding in plain sight in real-world locations. Actor Josh Peck, who hilariously commands the on-screen hijinks as he leads contestants through four rounds as they try to identify masterfully disguised sweets created by world-class cake artists. Escalating in difficulty round by round, the teams work together to determine what is cake and prove it with their teeth by biting into their best guess, all in pursuit of a total prize up to $12,000.
title: Sweet Deceit

overview: Realistic chronicle of everyday life during the Great War. A ranger collects in his family several Parisian children refugees because of the conflict. All share the life of the country village, the school, the news from the front.
title: La maison des bois

overview: Marco van Basten evolves from a quintessentially Dutch boy with a big soccer dream into a global phenomenon. We follow his journey from the youth fields to Ajax under the guidance of Johan Cruijff, and then on to his glory days at AC Milan. One of the absolute highlights is his wonder goal at the European Championship. But success comes at a price. How far will Van Basten go to fulfill his childhood dream?
title: Basta

overview: Limited Time Offer is an arched competition show where 10 pop-culture food junkies compete every week to create iconic brands, with the winning product available to the public the day after the episode airs.
title: Limited Time Offer

overview: One mistake in the documents for the apartment turns the life of the Malyutin family upside down - thanks to her, the apartment raider Baev appears in their house, who gets the right to use a share in real estate and begins to survive the owners of the only housing. Strictly within the law, but far beyond the bounds of humanity. Now Malyutin has to find out whether it is possible to defeat a professional neighbor on his own territory and which will be stronger: Baev's legal savvy or a family with nowhere else to go.
title: Профессиональ­ный сосед

overview: In the Berlin-Tiergarten-Mitte-West citizens' office, bureaucratic chaos collides with career ambitions: The new boss, Ronja, causes unrest with her attempts at optimization, while Conny keeps the place running smoothly. Amidst bureaucracy, office squabbles, and personal entanglements, everyday life at the office escalates in a wonderfully absurd way.
title: Nine to Five - Das Amt

overview: Mammoth follows Coach Tony Mammoth, a larger-than-life high school gym teacher whose life is put on ice in 1983, when he's buried in a freak ski avalanche. Forty years later, he thaws out to a world that has completely changed... but he's convinced it really didn't need to. Still clinging to life in the '80s - complete with his Burt Reynolds moustache and treasured Trans-AM -- Mammoth returns to the job he loves, only to discover that today's rules, relationships, and realities bear little resemblance to the world he once knew.
title: Mammoth

overview: Imperio de cristal centers on Sofía Vidal, whose life changes completely after attending a party at the mansion of the wealthy Lombardos—owners of a crystal factory—thereby unleashing dark secrets, family ambition, and the intrigues of Livia, the matriarch.
title: Imperio de cristal

overview: Sakuraba Junko is a part-time teacher at an English conversation school who dreams of one day working in New York. Junko strives hard to achieve her dreams, but New York seems a far distant reality. And she hasn't had much luck with romance for a while either. But things suddenly start to change when one day, Junko encounters a handsome Tokyo University graduate monk Hoshikawa Takane at a funeral service. Due to numbness of her legs after sitting for a long time, Junko accidentally knocks over the bowl of ashes, which falls right onto the head of Takene—probably the worst impression anyone could make. After such embarrassing mishap, Junko figures she would never see him again. However, the two end up meeting again in a matchmaking session that was set up by Junko's mother.
title: From Five to Nine

overview: Wunderschön! is a 90-minute travel program from WDR, in which different presenters explore popular holiday regions in Germany and Europe to offer viewers authentic travel tips, cultural insights, and hidden gems for the perfect vacation.
title: Wunderschön!

overview: High tension in the Alpine foothills: real emergencies, tough decisions, strong stories. The Lifesavers of Murnau shows medicine where it counts – told directly, closely and intensely. The series that follows the daily work of emergency physicians, nurses, and rescue teams at BG Unfallklinik Murnau, one of Germany's leading trauma hospitals located in the Bavarian Alps. Showing real emergency cases — from rescue operations in the mountains and severe traffic accidents to intensive care treatments, complex surgeries, and rehabilitation. With close-up footage from bodycams, drones, and cameras inside the trauma room, viewers experience how the medical teams handle life-threatening situations with precision and compassion.
title: Die Lebensretter von Murnau

overview: In höchster Not – Bergretter im Einsatz offers a captivating, unprecedented look at the work of the mountain rescue service. Through impressive visuals and an up-close perspective, it follows real rescue missions in the Bavarian Alps. The scope ranges from challenging helicopter rescues to the tireless search for missing hikers.
title: In höchster Not - Bergretter im Einsatz

overview: Spy legend Voss shocks his boss Haberland and his colleague Kocabay when he introduces them to the recruits he has chosen for their hands-on spy training: Sami, a perpetually cheerful teacher who believes her father is a top spy; Andi, a muscle-bound provincial policeman with a brilliant sense of smell; Vicky, an ambitious diplomat's daughter with catastrophic exam anxiety; Asel, a gifted mathematician with a photographic memory; and Yuki, a microsystems engineer who is virtually invisible to most people.
title: SpyOn

overview: Described as a prestige fantasy series where adventure collides with gothic horror and tragic romance, Ravenloft and its Domains of Dread tackle adventure through character-driven stories of dark magic and supernatural intrigue. At its heart, the series follows the making of the vampire Darklord Strahd von Zarovich, whose story of power, love, obsession, and undead transformation charts his origins from tragic antihero to one of Dungeons & Dragons' most notorious villains.
title: Ravenloft

overview: Elli Kempfer returns to her hometown of Steinau in the Karwendel Mountains to work as a paramedic and save the lives of accident victims. Her mother, Luise, raised her on her own. Leo, Luise's best friend, is like a surrogate father to Elli. She lives on her mother's farm and has ADHD. Because of this, Elli has a unique way of perceiving and experiencing the world. However, this also gives her a special strength time and again. Elli is open about it and has found her own way to structure her daily life and overcome challenges at work.
title: Einfach Elli

overview: After the accident in which her parents die, little Cecilia must go to live in Guanajuato with her aunts Evangelina and Natalia Vizcaíno, both single and very different from each other. Natalia loves Cecilia like a mother, but Evangelina always looks for a way to break the illusions of the girl and make her suffer, for which Cecilia has a deep fear of her.
title: Cadenas de amargura

overview: After her mother's death, engineering student Belinda's life is shaken when her father reveals he has another family. Forced to live with them, she falls in love with her stepsister's boyfriend.
title: Belinda

overview: Clickbait Clinic with Stacey Dooley will uncover the truth behind some of the wildest health trends taking over our social media feeds. 1 in 3 Brits now turn to social media for health advice, but how can we sort the miracle cures from the snake oil? Stacey will work with leading doctors and scientists to learn about the internet's most hyped medical claims: from fitness boosters to pain beaters, youth elixirs to fat busters, the team will trace the digital breadcrumbs to figure out how a trend went viral, meet the key influencers driving the buzz, and put the science to the test. With NHS waiting lists growing, and with social media playing an increasing role in all of our lives, The Clickbait Clinic's final verdict could be life changing... or lifesaving.
title: Clickbait Clinic with Stacey Dooley

overview: Jill & Dad's America is about Jill Wagner and her dad, David, who take a wild RV cross-country road trip across America.
title: Jill & Dad's America

overview: Швидкарі (Ambulances) is a dynamic series about emergency medical teams, their daily work, difficult decisions, team support and human stories that change both doctors and patients. The story unfolds around an unusual experiment in the capital. Frontline paramedic Max Kovalenko seeks to implement a new, more effective system of responding to calls, namely paramedics. He is convinced that the modern system of work of paramedics will help save people faster and more efficiently. To prove this, Max proposes an unusual professional competition between two emergency medical teams. His main rival is an experienced doctor Anatoly Savchuk, who has been working according to the principles of the "old school" for many years.
title: Швидкарі

overview: Lorena is in platonic love with famous singer and actor Eduardo Casablanca, who is a famous actor and singer; knows a cocktail presentation of his latest album and his first soap opera star. Some time later, Lorena goes on vacation to Ixtapa, where Eduardo is recording some stars in the soap opera. The illusion and fantasy of young love, the drive to invent an affair with Eduardo, which is followed with interest by her colleagues, who like her, are great fans of his. When Lorena is discovered, she falls into depression and loses all interest in life despite the efforts of her mother Norma and best friend Aurora. Eduardo intuits the sensitivity of a secret friend to send anonymous letters, inadvertently confessing a beautiful feeling, has a reunion with Lorena and kisses her impulsively and she doesn't understand. Lorena is discovered by Joaquin, the representative of Eduardo and begins a successful career closely watched by Deborah, who is bent on destroying his artistic life and his relationship with the singer.
title: Alcanzar una estrella

overview: DKDA is a group of young artists who have been a successful group for 10 years. They are: Rodrigo, Karla, Axel, Camila, Mateo, Regina and Brenda. They have shared so much that the seven consider themselves a family, with flaws and virtues. From the beginning they have always been supported by Eduardo Arias and his wife ´´Angela. He is the producer of the band and he will always be willing to risk everything to defend it from two thieves and careerists. For her part, Laura is a young DKDA fanatic. Her biggest support is her mother Rita hers. The two have followed the trajectory of the artists from the beginning, since Laura is in love with Rodrigo. Laura's life will change when she will have her first conversation in person with the singer who for 10 years has been her idol and her love. From that moment on, differences were born between Brenda and Laura, since from being a simple fan she would become an important part of the band and gave life to Rodrigo.
title: DKDA: Sueños de juventud

overview: Oyuki Ogino lives in a Japanese village in the early 1970s. She is a beautiful, honest, good woman whose beauty and physical attributes are used by her ambitious brother Yutaka Ogino, who exploits her and forces her to work as a Geisha.
title: El pecado de Oyuki

overview: When a young noblewoman becomes pregnant and her authoritarian father orders the baby destroyed to hide the disgrace, her loyal nanny rescues and raises the child in secret—never imagining that, years later, the boy, now a doctor, will save his own grandfather's life.
title: El derecho de nacer

overview: Little Estefanía is celebrating her birthday and her grandfather, a millionaire, is organizing an impressive party for her. Estefanía's father, Octavio, tired of his father-in-law's humiliation, has a macabre plan that involves the disappearance of his daughter.
title: En Carne Propia

overview: A captivating documentary blending 3D reconstructions with expert commentary from historians. Long regarded as a bloodthirsty tyrant, the Roman Emperor Nero is now undergoing a historical re-evaluation. In this first installment, ancient historians Mischa Meier and Claudia Tiersch, alongside church historian Christoph Markschies, examine the emperor's life (37–68 AD), precisely highlighting both his often-overlooked talents and his failings. The son of Agrippina, Nero felt compelled to have her executed to put an end to their ceaseless power struggles. Furthermore, the emperor faced opposition from the elite, who mocked his artistic ambitions and failed to understand his disapproval of gladiatorial combat and wars of expansion. Nero's notorious reputation stems largely from the vindictiveness of chroniclers belonging to the ruling class—a group whose influence he had consistently curtailed.
title: Néron: Plaidoyer pour un monstre

overview: Salvador de Mujeres tells the story of a successful boxer who loses everything and becomes an escort for wealthy women to save his family.
title: Salvador de Mujeres

overview: Set in the late 1950s during the rise of rock and roll, the story follows Pilar, a popular young woman who falls in love with the ambitious Bruno, who is only interested in fame and adventure. As love triangles, friendships, and rivalries unfold, a group of teenagers pursues their dreams while discovering the joys and challenges of first love, music, and growing up.
title: Baila conmigo

overview: For better or for worse... At Lulu and Leon's wedding, he is arrested and led away by police. With the bereaved bride down on her luck, the scene is set for TV3's new, poignant drama, Lulu & Leon. Lulu is a self-employed mother of two with her own hair salon. For 10 years she has lived with Leon, a devoted and charismatic father, but unfortunately also a bit of a habitual offender, which finally catches up with him. The bride is left behind with a lot of problems. How can she pay the wages to her employees when the bank has tied up all her money? How can she provide for her 9-year-old, a little quiet son, when one disaster after another makes her life a chaos? How can she explain to her 15-year-old daughter that it is a bad idea to be the girlfriend of a criminal, when she herself has chosen the same? In Leon's absence, Lulu is forced even farther into his criminal network; a male-dominated world of gangster types, suspect tinkering, prostitutes, and not least the charming and very committed criminal Commissioner Patrick Smith and his colleague Ole Sound.
title: Lulu & Leon

overview: Prehistoric Park is a Docu-fiction television mini-series that premiered on ITV on 22 July 2006 and on Animal Planet on 29 October 2006. The program was produced by Impossible Pictures, who also created Walking with Dinosaurs. A blend of speculation, science and CGI simulates an imaginary present-day park containing creatures from the distant past. In each episode, zoologist and wildlife expert Nigel Marven travels back to the Cretaceous, Pleistocene, Paleozoic and other time periods to understand what killed these creatures and then brings them back to his park, where special effects allow the ancient wildlife to mingle with present-day animals. The program is narrated by David Jason and presented by Nigel Marven.
title: Prehistoric Park
